RX9070XT's power consumption is IMMENSELY higher than that of the 5070Ti, on the long run (3-4-5 years OR more) the price difference is paid in the electricity bill.

The 5070Ti is WAY BETTER when it comes to productivity, there's a world of performance between the 5070Ti and 9070XT in productivity.
The 5070Ti is going to retain it's value way more than the 9070XT because it is good for productivity
